rationale: The browser capture now launches Chrome with --force-device-scale-factor at the capture's DPR, which it already emulates through Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride, so the emulated and real device scales agree. Chrome composites backdrop-filter at the browser's own scale, and with the two disagreeing a frosted box was captured with unblurred streaks. Only the capture browser's launch scale changes; the capture protocol, its outputs, DesignIR, the renderer and packaging are untouched, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
